caption: Our go-to snack that’s super quick & easy yet delicious & nutritious:  - 2-3 spoons of non-fat Greek yogurt  - With flax seeds, chia seeds, hemp seeds, and sunflower seeds  - Along with  @ikigai_fruits that are naturally sweet & delicious Flax seeds, chia seeds, hemp seeds, and sunflower seeds are excellent sources of healthy fats and essential minerals for supporting rapid brain growth.  The key is to serve with fruits that are naturally sweet and delicious so that there’s no need for added sugar.  The natural sugars in fruit are accompanied by fiber and other nutrients, which slow down the absorption of sugar into the bloodstream. This makes fruit less likely to cause blood sugar spikes compared to added sugars.  I love serving @ikigai_fruits as their fruits are exceptionally tasty with premium quality, sourced from small Japanese farms known for craftsmanship and innovation to preserve quality.  #workingmom #wfh #nycmom #toddlereats #toddlersnacks #blw #babyfood #healthysnacks #easysnacks #snacksforkids #snackideas
